import csv, gzip, io, re, sys, urllib.request
counts_path, sizes_path = sys.argv[1:3]
url = 'https://www.axolotl-omics.org/dl/AmexT_v47-AmexG_v6.0-DD.gtf.gz'

chunks = {}
order = []
with open(sizes_path, 'rt') as f:
    for row in csv.reader(f, delimiter='\t'):
        if not row: continue
        name, n = row[0], int(row[1])
        arm = re.sub(r'_\d+$', '', name)
        start = sum(x[2] for x in chunks.get(arm, []))
        chunks.setdefault(arm, []).append((name, start, n))
        order.append(name)
chunk_set = set(order)

with open(counts_path, 'rt') as f:
    rd = csv.reader(f, delimiter='\t')
    header = next(rd)
    nrows = 0
    bad_chunks = set()
    for row in rd:
        nrows += 1
        if row and row[0] not in chunk_set:
            bad_chunks.add(row[0])

req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
raw = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120).read()
gene_count = 0
chrom_counts = {}
mapped = 0
examples = []
with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as gz:
    for b in gz:
        line = b.decode('utf-8')
        if not line or line[0] == '#': continue
        p = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
        if len(p) < 9 or p[2] != 'gene': continue
        gene_count += 1
        chrom = p[0]
        chrom_counts[chrom] = chrom_counts.get(chrom, 0) + 1
        if chrom in chunks:
            tss = int(p[3]) - 1 if p[6] != '-' else int(p[4]) - 1
            for cname, off, length in chunks[chrom]:
                if off <= tss < off + length:
                    mapped += 1
                    if len(examples) < 5:
                        examples.append((chrom, tss, cname, tss-off))
                    break

with open('summary.txt','w') as out:
    out.write('samples=' + ','.join(header[3:]) + '\n')
    out.write(f'count_columns={len(header)} count_rows={nrows} chunks={len(order)} arms={len(chunks)} bad_chunk_names={len(bad_chunks)}\n')
    out.write(f'gtf_bytes={len(raw)} genes={gene_count} gtf_chromosomes={len(chrom_counts)} mapped_genes={mapped}\n')
    out.write('gtf_chrom_top=' + ','.join(f'{k}:{v}' for k,v in sorted(chrom_counts.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])[:30]) + '\n')
    out.write('mapping_examples=' + ';'.join(map(str,x) for x in examples) + '\n')
